description: This Java source file defines a command handler class UpdateEmailConfigurationCommandHandler used for handling update commands related to email configuration within the Fineract system. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface and delegates the update operation to the EmailConfigurationWritePlatformService.

classes.name: UpdateEmailConfigurationCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles update commands for email configuration by implementing the NewCommandSourceHandler interface and delegating update operations to the EmailConfigurationWritePlatformService.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the update command by delegating to the writePlatformService's update method, returning the result as a CommandProcessingResult.
